what: Postbump edge case conflicts with the planned bash STATUS contract
scenario_or_breakage: Line 41 says result.status must not contain *-push-skipped, but line 105 says postbump must keep emitting *-push-skipped. That can preserve the old Python status tokens and fail parity.
suggested_fix: Rewrite the edge case to say result.status=ok with force_push_status=skipped-repo-unavailable or absent, matching bash.
